# Room conversation (#4790, #4791, #4793)

Retention: retained as bounded before/after review evidence for #4790, #4791 and #4793. Replace only with superseding reviewed evidence.

Images live on the orphan branch `pr-assets/room-conversation-4810`, pinned at commit `dc79d4ccb691` (repository PNGs are ignored by `.gitignore`); `receipt.json` lists each file's SHA-256.

Before: today's Project room and Task room components (origin/main `c493a11367da`) rendered through this PR's room gallery scenes and fixtures. After: the shared `RoomConversation` and `RoomComposer` at `2b9a75fe232d`, merged with origin/main `87730c88104c`, including the #4810 review, delta, round-2, gallery-findings and both gallery-delta rounds' fixes. On phones each message now has a visible ⋯ More actions button. The Task-room scenes serve their Task from fixture routes, so the Task title carries no run suffix. The `agent-pending` and `agent-abandon` scenes were added in round 2, and `keyboard` in gallery delta 2; they have no before. All are local captures on an isolated e2e Station; every PNG was opened at 390 and 1440 in both themes. Times follow the capturing host's time zone.

These scenes are new, so there is no tracked baseline and no pixel comparison (`NOT_VERIFIED: 44 new / 0 comparisons`). They are visual receipts, not a full-gallery qualification, and they do not cover native shells or physical devices. Reactions have no scene: no room contract carries them yet.

[Design sketch](design-sketch.md) written before implementation.
